title: Distilling Routed 3D Privilege for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.12355v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness of vision-language models (VLMs), because RGB inputs do not directly provide geometric evidence. Existing remedies either inject 3D into the model at inference, paying architecture and latency costs, or train with outcome rewards that supervise only the final answer. Spatial errors originate in perception: a misjudged depth or direction can be corrected only by the scene's true geometry, which the 3D-scanned sources of spatial training corpora already provide. We propose GPD (Geometry-Privileged Distillation), which makes geometric evidence the privilege in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). For each question, depth, semantic, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) cues are rendered as compact text and routed to the teacher alongside the reference answer; a privileged KL, applied only to incorrect trajectories, augments GRPO, and the deployed model remains RGB-only. On the 4B backbone, GPD achieves 5

translated_title: 面向视觉语言模型空间推理的路由式3D特权蒸馏
translated_abstract: 空间推理一直是视觉语言模型（VLM）的一个持续性弱点，因为RGB输入并不直接提供几何证据。现有的解决方法要么在推理时将3D信息注入模型，付出架构和延迟上的代价，要么使用仅监督最终答案的结果奖励进行训练。空间错误源于感知：对深度或方向的误判只能通过场景的真实几何来纠正，而空间训练语料库的3D扫描来源本身已经提供了这种真实几何信息。我们提出GPD（几何特权蒸馏，Geometry-Privileged Distillation），将几何证据作为在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中的特权信息。对于每个问题，深度、语义和鸟瞰图（BEV）线索被渲染为紧凑的文本，与参考答案一起路由给教师模型；一种仅应用于错误轨迹的特权KL散度用于增强GRPO，而部署的模型仍然保持仅使用RGB输入。在4B骨干网络上，GPD实现了5（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: GPD将深度、语义和鸟瞰图等3D几何线索作为特权信息仅提供给教师模型，通过仅作用于错误轨迹的特权KL散度增强GRPO在线自蒸馏训练，使部署的纯RGB视觉语言模型在推理时无需任何3D输入或架构改动即可大幅提升空间推理能力。
en_tdlr: GPD routes depth, semantic, and bird's-eye-view 3D cues as privileged information to the teacher during on-policy self-distillation, augmenting GRPO with a privileged KL applied only to incorrect trajectories, so the deployed RGB-only VLM substantially improves spatial reasoning without any 3D inputs or architectural changes at inference.
